name: Sets it (bridge)
engine: Cut-backs from the right count as layoffs, so the layoff pieces pay off on the flank.
about: The bridge between the loaded flank and the layoff engine. Porro and Yamal load the right and cut it back; a cut-back or cross to Oyarzabal counts as a layoff (Sets it), and he can hold it up and lay it off to Olmo, who is unmarked (Lays it off). Because the flank's cut-backs are layoffs, Third man runs and Rehearsed layoff read them: a cut-back that comes off sets Yamal running as the third man and, after the first layoff of the match, every layoff costs no decision. Olmo, unmarked, needs only 2 for a clean win on his shot (Cool head).
decisions: Cut it back to Oyarzabal rather than shooting from the angle: it is a layoff, it sets Olmo, and it counts towards the rehearsed layoff.
Oyarzabal in their box: shoot, or lay it off to Olmo unmarked with Cool head.
The right flank or the middle: the overlap and the pass to the loaded flank make men unmarked.
